test_cases.name: ListClusters 操作与参数（语法）
test_cases.expected: KooCLI prints the ListClusters help (path param project_id; NO query parameters — official API fact)

test_cases.name: 集群列表真实只读查询（live）
test_cases.expected: Returns the cluster list JSON ({"clusters": [...]}) or an explicit 403 permission envelope

test_cases.name: 脚本表格输出（默认 ListClusters）
test_cases.expected: Aligned table with id/name/status/status_meaning/version/instance_count/instances columns (or an explicit permission/empty message)

test_cases.name: 名称/状态筛选（客户端）
test_cases.expected: Only matching clusters are listed; no match prints the friendly empty message with the active filters

test_cases.name: 集群详情视图（ShowClusterDetail）
test_cases.expected: Field/value detail table incl. per-instance status/IPs

test_cases.name: 脚本导出 JSON / Markdown / CSV
test_cases.expected: Writes a JSON file and prints the path

test_cases.name: 写意图守卫拦截
test_cases.expected: Exit 1, [错误] 检测到写操作意图 ... 已被守卫拦截, no command executed

test_cases.name: 离线单元测试
test_cases.expected: All offline unit tests pass (mocked hcloud): guard / resolve / command build / JSON+envelope / filters / normalize / SDK fallback / renderers / atomic export / fake-binary e2e / --help

env_vars_required: 以 HUAWEI/HW/HWC/CLOUD_SDK 开头的环境变量中匹配 AK/SK 的键值对
notes: 只读操作（CDM ListClusters / ShowClusterDetail，均为 GET），无集群创建/删除/重启/扩容风险；导出文件仅在本机生成，绝不写回云端。CLI 主路径使用 hcloud CDM（经 skill-quality-cli 包裹）；SDK 回退使用 huaweicloudsdkcdm v1（BasicCredentials，project_id 可由 SDK 经 IAM 自动解析）；SDK 缺失时运行 scripts/ensure_env.py 自动安装。写意图守卫拦截变更意图，其行为由离线单元测试（TC-10）覆盖。ListClusters 需要 IAM 权限 cdm:cluster:list，ShowClusterDetail 需要 cdm:cluster:get；缺权限时脚本给出明确的权限错误提示。真实只读验证由 QA 带外执行。
